# AGT-CTL-03

**Is human approval protected from manipulation and from automation bias?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | CTL: Control and accountability |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A reviewer |
| Applies when | any tool has approval human-approved |
| Reads | `elements.agent.tools.approval`, `decisions` |

## Why it matters

An approval prompt written by the agent can be the attack; a reviewer who approves everything is no control.
